The latest version of MGLTools is [1.5.7](1.5.7/index.qmd). The CCSB site has no separate
documentation for 1.5.7; the most recent documentation is for version 1.5.6.

## MGLTools 1.5.6

- [About 1.5.6](1.5.6/index.qmd): components and tutorials
- [Tutorials](1.5.6/tutorials.qmd): PMV and Vision tutorials (PDF slides)
- [Release notes](1.5.6/release-notes.qmd)

| Page | Covers |
|---|---|
| [PMV's GUI](1.5.6/pmv-gui.qmd) | menus, toolbar, status bar |
| [Widget panel](1.5.6/widget-panel.qmd) | the panel left of the 3D Viewer |

| [Tools panel](1.5.6/tools-panel.qmd) | [measuring](1.5.6/measure.qmd), [geometry](1.5.6/geometry-tools.qmd) and [camera](1.5.6/camera.qmd) tools |
